display.purpose: Hero headline through the Sena Display CSS alias.

body.purpose: Body text through the Sena Text CSS alias.

motion.name: envelope-letter
motion.purpose: Envelope opening. Reduced-motion preference removes animation.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Invitation opening, event directions, and RSVP submission.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:13px 24px; border:0; border-radius:10px; background:#222222; color:#fff; font:700 14px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-button:hover { background:#45412f; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #222222; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.7; cursor:wait; }

components.name: Name field
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">Nama kamu / keluarga *</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="Tulis nama kamu di sini">
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#222222; font:700 12px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:46px; padding:12px; border:1px solid #aaa79e; border-radius:7px; background:#fff; color:#222222; font:13px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; caret-color:#b02a24; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#69665e; opacity:1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #222222; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Attendance choice
components.html: <label class="ds-choice"><input type="radio" checked name="ds-attendance"> Iya, aku datang!</label>
components.css: .ds-choice { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; min-height:48px; padding:10px; border:1px solid #aaa79e; border-radius:7px; color:#222222; font:700 11px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-choice:has(input:checked) { background:#fff3bb; border-color:#70601e; } .ds-choice input { accent-color:#222222; width:15px; height:15px; margin:0; } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #222222; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Event board
components.description: Rotated white paper for event facts.
components.css: .ds-board { padding:30px; background:#fff; color:#222222; border-radius:4px; transform:rotate(2deg); box-shadow:0 14px 32px #56350014; font:700 10px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; text-align:center; } .ds-board span { display:block; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-board strong { display:block; color:#b42b24; font:800 88px/1.1 "Sena Display", "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif; } .ds-board p { font-size:17px; }

components.name: Mobile navigation
components.description: Fixed navigation rendered here as an inline preview.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:7px; border-radius:14px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 5px 35px #22222226; } .ds-nav a { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:1; min-height:44px; padding:12px 10px; color:#222222; text-decoration:none; font:700 11px "Sena Text", Nunito, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:last-child { background:#ffd22e; border-radius:8px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #222222; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
Sena’s first-birthday invitation uses the approved toy-excavator and scrapbook direction. Yellow sections, white paper photographs, orange tape, red birthday accents, and dark text frame a warm family celebration.

This design system applies to `/birthday/sena` and its invitation components. The established portfolio, blog, gallery, and wedding surfaces retain their own visual systems.
keyCharacteristics: Toy excavators and layered paper keepsakes
Condensed bold headings with rounded body text
Large yellow sections and white photograph frames
dos: Use the documented palette and locally hosted birthday fonts within `/birthday/sena`.
Preserve the main Sena portrait, paper framing, tape, and excavator imagery.
Keep event details, directions, calendar download, and RSVP easy to reach.
donts: Avoid applying this surface-specific design system to the portfolio, blog, gallery, or wedding pages.
